title: Perplexity Open-Sourced Its Agent Jail
content:
[TITLE: Perplexity Open-Sourced Its Agent Jail]

[HOOK: face, serious tone]
What if your AI agent...
accidentally DELETES your files?

[SCREEN: Perplexity blog - Open-sourcing SPACE | Oct 15, 2026 | Source: perplexity.ai/hub]
That exact fear is what this solves.
Perplexity just made it OPEN SOURCE.
It's called SPACE.

[CAM: medium]
This is the same sandbox
that runs their "Computer" agent.
In July, they built it in-house
to replace an outside provider...
and now the code is free for everyone.

[GRAPHIC: Isolation / State recovery / Credential + network controls | Source: perplexity.ai/hub]
So what's a sandbox?
Think of it as a LOCKED room.
The agent works inside that room...
and it can't touch anything outside it.
That's isolation.
Something went wrong? You RECOVER the state.
Roll it back, like nothing happened.
No panic. No lost work. Just a clean restart.
And passwords, internet access...
those stay under YOUR control.
The agent only gets what you give it.

[CAM: close-up]
Now, the builder's angle.
Building an agent is EASY now.
Anyone can do it in an afternoon.
Making that agent SAFE... that's the real work.
And it's the first thing every client asks me:
"Is this going to break something?"
"Can it mess up our data?"
If you can't answer that with confidence,
you don't have a product.
You have a demo.

[SCREEN: GitHub repo + setup docs]
The setup instructions
and the security guide are right there in the repo.
If you're building agents...
read this FIRST.
Before you give any agent access to real files,
real accounts, or real customer data.

[CAM: face]
Agents are only going to get more powerful.
Which means the room they work in
matters more than ever.

[CTA: face]
Want a SAFE AI agent for your business?
DM me 'AI'.
